## How did you verify it?

Please be specific. "Scanned on iPhone 14 and Pixel 7, contact imported with all

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or the reason is explained above)
- [ ] No network requests, analytics, or telemetry introduced
- [ ] Still usable by keyboard alone, and at mobile widths

If this changes the encoded payload or how the code is rendered:

- [ ] Scanned with a real phone camera, not just a desktop decoder
- [ ] Tested on iOS **and** Android (note below if you only had one)
- [ ] Confirmed the fields actually landed correctly in the saved contact
- [ ] Checked both vCard and MECARD, and at error correction `L` as well as `H`
